That row is struck: the radius tracks the dynamical mass, entailed rather than observed. What its own measurement could NOT do is discriminate -- the ensemble ratios run 1.20 to 2.33 above the spherical bound at the dynamical mass, and the authors leading explanation is the systematic the corpus had named, virial mass substituting for turnaround mass. DISCHARGE: an ensemble with masses measured inside the turnaround rather than at the virial radius, with the radius still independent of internal dynamics. The bound-to-attained factor is parameter-free and the guard is four-way, so the instrument is built and only the sample is missing. r6893 (66) RUNS THE SWEEP AND CORRECTS THIS ROW OWN PREMISE. The row says the authors leading explanation for the excess is the systematic the corpus had named, a virial mass standing in for a turnaround mass. It is the right systematic and it is not large enough: the bound goes as M^(1/3), so rescuing a ratio R needs M_ta/M_vir = R^3 -- 12.6, 5.4, 6.4, 6.0, 2.6, 1.7 for the six groups -- against a measured turnaround-to-virial mass ratio of 1.2 to 2.2 in the caustic ensembles. It accounts for the two mildest rows and not the four largest, though none of the six is individually significant on its own error bar. AND THE TWO ENSEMBLES THAT LOOK USABLE ARE CIRCULAR, measured here and not read off: both define their outer radius at a FIXED OVERDENSITY rather than measuring it, and at rho_bar = 3.5 rho_c the ratio of that radius to the bound is (Omega_Lambda/1.75)^(1/3) = 0.737, at 5.56 rho_c it is 0.632 -- pure numbers carrying no datum, identical for every cluster in either sample. No published catalogue carries a kinematic turnaround radius AND an enclosed mass at it; every candidate fails one side. The direction of the correction is itself contested: the caustic route puts the turnaround-enclosed mass above the virial one, the Local Volume flow route puts the mass inside the zero-velocity surface at about six tenths of it, and settling that comes first because the row arithmetic runs through it. Coma now has a kinematic turnaround radius, a caustic profile and wide-field lensing on one object, so the single-object version is reachable; the ENSEMBLE is not, and assembling one is a reanalysis of public redshifts rather than a new survey. The corpus is not exposed: P3 states the radius as general relativity with Lambda and says it discriminates no cosmology, and the landed confrontation is the Local Group, where the mass is measured independently of the radius.r7013 -- THE TWO EXITS, AND THE SECOND ONE IS A MEASUREMENT RATHER THAN A WAIT. WHAT WOULD DISCHARGE IT is already stated: an ensemble with masses measured inside the turnaround and the radius still independent of internal dynamics. OR TERMINATES IF: it is demonstrated that no such ensemble can be built from data that exists OR IS PLANNED, every route being either definitionally circular as the two fixed-overdensity samples are, or data-limited as the caustic route is -- IN WHICH CASE THE TERMINAL STATE IS THAT THE BOUND IS A PARAMETER-FREE PREDICTION AWAITING AN INSTRUMENT, a statement about the skys current reach and not about this construction. Which turns this row from an indefinite wait into one bounded measurement: it has already established that no PUBLISHED catalogue carries both sides, so what is owed is the same check against the instruments actually planned, made once and then stated. r7027 -- THE LIVE CLAUSE BLOCK. This register is append-forward, so an amended exit condition APPENDS and never supersedes, and a reader coming down a row meets the OLDEST clause first with nothing to tell it from the current one. Measured at r7027, one row carried FIVE terminal clauses and EIGHT discharge clauses set across five revisions of a single day -- each right when it was made, only the last live, and the gate reporting the row green throughout because it checked that a clause was PRESENT where the question is which one is CURRENT. So every open row now carries exactly one live-clause block naming the revision that set it, check_remainder_chains requires exactly one, and the clause counts are printed rather than hidden. For this row the live clause is unchanged in substance and is now stated in one place: WHAT WOULD DISCHARGE IT, an ensemble with masses measured inside the turnaround rather than at the virial radius and the radius still independent of internal dynamics; OR TERMINATES IF it is demonstrated that no such ensemble can be built from data that exists OR IS PLANNED, every route being either definitionally circular as the two fixed-overdensity samples are or data-limited as the caustic route is -- with the terminal state being that the bound is a parameter-free prediction awaiting an instrument, a statement about the skys current reach and not about this construction. Which makes the second exit ONE BOUNDED MEASUREMENT rather than an indefinite wait: the same catalogue check run against the instruments actually planned, made once and then stated. r7207: THE SECOND EXIT IS RUN AND IT CLOSES NEGATIVE -- THE ENSEMBLE IS BEING BUILT, so this is a row waiting for a sample somebody is building, which is the one thing r7027 said it did not know. r7027 bounded this row by turning its terminal condition into ONE check, the same catalogue check run against the instruments actually PLANNED, made once and then stated; that check had sat unrun for ninety revisions while this seat reported the row as not having moved. IT IS THE SECOND CASE. CHANCES, the Chilean Cluster Galaxy Evolution Survey on 4MOST, targets about 100 clusters -- fifty at z below 0.07 and fifty across 0.07 to 0.45, plus two superclusters -- OUT TO 5 r200, which its own authors state corresponds roughly to the TURNAROUND RADIUS, at about 4,500 redshifts per low-z cluster and 2,500 per evolution cluster, over five years. 4MOST took first light on 18 October 2025. So the terminal condition, that no such ensemble can be built from data that exists or is planned, is FALSE and the row does not terminate. AND IT CLEARS BOTH DISQUALIFICATIONS THIS ROW ESTABLISHED: a caustic radius is kinematic and is not defined at a fixed overdensity, so the definitional circularity that struck the two fixed-overdensity ensembles does not reach it; and the caustic route was struck as data-limited rather than definitional, which is the defect a survey of this redshift density at this radius removes. THE NEAR-TERM INSTRUMENT IS THE COUNTER-EXAMPLE and is recorded so this is not read as any new survey will do: CATARSIS, on TARSIS at Calar Alto, takes 16 clusters at 500-1000 redshifts each but targets within 2 x R200,c, short of the turnaround by design. The discriminator is the RADIAL REACH, and only one of the two planned programmes has it. WHAT IS LEFT IS NOT A WAIT: the live obstruction r7027 named is untouched -- the DIRECTION of the correction is contested in print, the caustic route putting the turnaround-enclosed mass above the virial one and the Local Volume flow route putting the mass inside the zero-velocity surface at about six tenths of it, with the rows arithmetic running through it. That disagreement is between published analyses, is not data-limited, is available now and is this seats. The r7027 terminal condition is retired as ANSWERED rather than carried forward and is replaced. The corpus is no more exposed than r6893 found it: the ensemble was never load-bearing and is not load-bearing now that it is coming. r7211: THE REMAINDER IS ANSWERED AND THE CONTESTED DIRECTION IS NOT CONTESTED -- the two numbers are two different quantities. r7207 left this rows live item as the contested direction of the correction and set the terminal condition on it; 60s r7222, pre-registered with its own prediction recorded WRONG, shows there is no contest. For any non-negative density the enclosed mass is non-decreasing and the turnaround surface lies OUTSIDE the virial radius, so the quotient is at least one identically; measured over four profile families and twenty-two members it runs 1.165 to 5.228. The caustic routes 1.2-2.2 is inside that and the Local Volumes six tenths is BELOW THE FLOOR, not at the other end of a range -- so one of them is a value the quotient cannot take, and the caustic sign is the only sign the quantity admits. AND THE BOUND REPRODUCES BOTH PURE NUMBERS THIS ROW BANKED FROM ONE IDENTITY: the spherical bound collapses to (r/R_ta)^3 = 2 Omega_Lambda / f, giving 0.7370 against the banked 0.737 and 0.6320 against 0.632, the two back-solving the SAME Omega_Lambda to 1.7 parts in a thousand -- so r7027s pure numbers carrying no datum are consequences of one formula, a stronger statement than the strike made. AND THE SAME LINE LOCATES THE SURFACE at R_ta = 5.23 r200, which is independently the 5 r200 that r7207s CHANCES note quotes as roughly the turnaround radius, derived with no fitted parameter. The rows live item is retired and what remains is the wait it always was, on a named instrument. OR TERMINATES IF the ensemble arrives and the quotient is unreadable against the bound for a reason the profile band already contains -- that band is a factor of 4.5, wide enough that the caustic number sitting inside it is consistency and not a test, which is the rows real remaining risk.  |
